blocks.text: LOS ANGELES, United States — Russian teenager Mirra Andreeva battled past Elina Svitolina in straight sets to win the season-ending WTA Finals crown on Sunday. Andreeva powered to a 7-5, 6-3 victory in a hard-fought duel in Indian Wells to complete a superb week in California. Reigning French Open champion Andreeva, 19, clinched the title […]...
